english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a fine imposed as punishment for breaking the law.

examples.english: They got a fine of five hundred dollars for illegal parking.
examples.traditional: 佢因為亂泊車，畀人罰款五百蚊。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 jan1 wai6 lyun6 paak3 ce1 bei2 jan4 fat6 fun2 ng5 baak3 man1
